sources.claim: The current KGP compatibility table lists Kotlin2.4.20 with Gradle7.6.3 through9.7.0 and AGP8.5.2 through9.3.1.

Gradle advises using its corresponding Kotlin DSL plugin; arbitrary Kotlin DSL plugin/Gradle combinations are not guaranteed. Its embedded Kotlin and external KGP standard-library compatibility are distinct concerns.
